# Third-party notices

The REST-only central test fixture installs the packages in `requirements.lock`.
Wheel metadata under Python `site-packages` retains each package's copyright and
license files.

## Python and base image

The pinned `python:3.13.15-slim-trixie` image contains CPython 3.13.15 and
Debian GNU/Linux trixie components. CPython uses the Python Software
Foundation License Version 2. Debian package notices remain under
`/usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright` in the image.
